latin: Magi in .xvii. amphorismo nihil aliud intelligunt per triplex indumentum ex lino, panno, et pellibus, quam triplex animae habitaculum, caeleste, spiritale, et terrenum.
translation: In the seventeenth aphorism, the magi understand by the threefold garment of linen, cloth, and skins nothing other than the threefold dwelling place of the soul: celestial, spiritual, and earthly.
